sword.name: Sword
sword.title: Knight · Sword
sword.play: Close to mid range, alternating normal strikes and rage skills. The spear is also playable in this class.
pros: Balanced offense and defense, easiest to master
Steady rhythm, seamless rage skill transitions
cons: Burst falls behind guns and spells
Less sturdy than hammer and axe

spear.name: Spear
spear.title: Knight · Spear
spear.play: Hold spacing and counter when they push in. The sword is also playable in this class.
pros: Bonus advantages on clash and counter

axe.name: Axe
axe.title: Viking · Axe
axe.play: Exploit openings with heavy strikes. The hammer is also playable in this class.
pros: Highly effective against heavy armor and stone fists
A single cleave strikes fear into foes

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.title: Viking · Hammer
hammer.play: Stand firm, soak damage, and outlast the foe. The axe is also playable in this class.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.title: Ninja · Dagger
dagger.tagline: Killing Intent Hidden in the Sleeve
dagger.play: Get in close with rapid stabbing combos. Darts are also playable in this class.

dart.name: Dart
dart.title: Ninja · Dart
dart.tagline: A Feint and Strike as One
dart.play: High-speed feints and dart volleys. Daggers are also playable in this class.
pros: Synergizes with reading tells through white fog

fist.name: Fist
fist.title: Monk · Fist
fist.play: Close in for relentless flurry strikes. Claws are also playable in this class.
pros: Smooth match against Abo in the dojo
Pairs well with crisis healing skills

claw.name: Claw
claw.title: Monk · Claw
claw.play: Rapid claw slash combos. Fists are also playable in this class.

magic.name: Staff
magic.title: Mage · Staff
magic.play: Set the rhythm with spells and soul vessels. Crystals are also playable in this class.
pros: Best synergy with combat souls and stargazing

crystal.name: Crystal
crystal.title: Mage · Crystal
crystal.tagline: Weave the Barrier into a Blade
crystal.play: Fight methodically, sustained by combat souls and barriers. The staff is also playable in this class.

bow.name: Bow
bow.title: Ranger · Bow
bow.tagline: One Who Waits for the Wind
bow.play: Keep distance and snipe safely. Guns are also playable in this class.

gun.name: Gun
gun.title: Ranger · Gun
gun.play: Snipe patiently from afar. The bow is also playable in this class.
pros: Potential to eliminate targets at range
